primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: The king made silver and gold to be as common as stones in Jerusalem, and he made cedars to be as common as the sycamore trees that are in the lowland.
The king made silver as common in Jerusalem as stones, and he made cedars to be as abundant as the sycamore trees that are in the lowland.

He built towers in the wilderness, and dug out many cisterns, for he had much livestock, both in the lowland and in the plain. He had farmers and vineyard keepers in the mountains and in the fertile fields, for he loved agriculture.

The Philistines also invaded the cities of the lowland, and of the South of Judah, and had taken Beth Shemesh, Aijalon, Gederoth, Soco with its villages, Timnah with its villages, and Gimzo with its villages. They lived there.
